fact: For the second quarter of 2020 the SNIS division's table of reports in DHIS2, extracted on 28 August 2020, shows 52,625 of 53,736 expected basic-services reports (97.9%) and 5,648 of 6,249 expected hospital-service reports (90.4%), with overall completeness of 78.7% and timeliness of 42.8% across 11 data sets.
title: Retro information globale aux DPS à l’issue d’analyse des données du SNIS au 2ème trimestre 2020
publisher: Division du Système National d’Information Sanitaire (SNIS), Ministère de la Santé
